ja340:1.1: Adāsi dānāni pure Visayha, dadato ca te khayadhammo ahosi, itoparañ ce na dadeyya dānaṃ tiṭṭheyyuṃ te saṃñamantassa bhogā ti.
ja340:2.1: Anariyam ariyena sahassanetta suduggatenāpi akiccam āhu, mā vo dhanan taṃ ahuvā janinda yambhogahetu vijahemu saddhaṃ.
ja340:3.1: Yena eko ratho yāti yāti tenāparo ratho, porāṇaṃ nihitaṃ vaḍḍhaṃ vaḍḍhataṃ ñeva Vāsava.
ja340:4.1: Yadi hessati dassāma, asante kiṃ dadāmase, evaṃ bhūtāpi dassāma, mā dānaṃ pamadamhase ti.
